summary.headline: Astrological Testimonies and Errata
summary.text: Concluding astrological guidance says to compare conflicting good and bad testimonies, preferring the stronger testimony with more dignities and rejecting both when they are equal. An errata list corrects readings, omitted words, and sign and planet symbols across the book, including errors involving the ninth and tenth houses, Capricorn, Sagittarius, Mercury, and Mars.
